A hosepipe ban doesn't ban all water use 💧
Its official name is a Temporary Use Ban (TUB). Only water companies can bring one in, under section 76 of the Water Industry Act 1991. It covers things like watering the garden, washing a private car or filling a paddling pool with a hosepipe. Watering cans, water butts and buckets are still fine. In past droughts, TUBs cut the water put into supply by 3 to 5%.

Has your area had a hosepipe ban? Comment your town 👇
Source: Environment Agency, Thames Water
